name: What are closing costs for a pre-construction condo?

mainEntity.name: What are closing costs for a pre-construction condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Closing costs for pre-construction condos in Florida can include standard fees like title insurance, recording fees, and attorney fees, but often also involve additional developer-specific fees. These may include impact fees, utility connection charges, and a capital contribution to the condominium association. Buyers should budget for these costs, which can sometimes be 3-5% of the purchase price, and review them carefully with their agent.
acceptedAnswer.description: Closing costs for pre-construction condos in Florida include standard fees plus additional developer charges like impact and utility connection fees.
